calls.statement:
SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m, s.store_id < 900 AS physical, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS n_rl,
 sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) s999
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-25' AND DATE '2024-10-05'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m, p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, p.category = 'ZZ Test' AS test, count(*) n,
 sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(f.net_amount) net,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatch,
 min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH l AS (
 SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) m, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 GROUP BY 1),
r AS (
 SELECT date_trunc('month', business_date) m, sum(net_sales_before_returns) nsbr, sum(receipts) rc, count(DISTINCT store_id) stores
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1),
tot AS (SELECT count(*) n_all FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30')
SELECT l.m, l.net, r.nsbr, l.net - r.nsbr diff, l.n, l.stores, r.stores, (SELECT n_all FROM tot) FROM l JOIN r USING (m) ORDER BY 1

SELECT strftime(f.sale_date, '%B %Y') AS month, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS store_sales_incl_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
  AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', f.sale_date), 1
ORDER BY date_trunc('month', f.sale_date)
